name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu clashes; no city changed hands
summary: Clashes across North and South Kivu; no major city changed hands
state: Clashes between the M23-led alliance and pro-government forces continued in North and South Kivu in late October, including in the Minembwe highlands, Walikale and Rutshuru, with 'no operationally significant changes on the ground' (Critical Threats, 28 Oct). On 28 Oct the US sanctioned Rwanda's Ministry of Defence for supporting the rebellion. No major city had changed hands as of 2 Nov.
for_you: The conflict affects supply of minerals such as coltan and tin used in electronics.
rubric_hit: Active fighting; no major city captured = Watch

sources.title: Critical Threats — Congo War Security Review, 28 Oct
Washington Post — US sanctions Rwanda over M23

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
